leads.summary: A small software team that builds custom apps, websites and software for clients on contract, and also sells its own products in e-commerce, digital business cards and IoT.
leads.hook: Their site lists their own e-commerce, digital-business-card and IoT products alongside contract custom-software work.
leads.angle_reason: Client apps and e-commerce products like theirs need the same Django REST backend with JWT auth and per-user data isolation that MedVault uses.

leads.summary: Open-source digital credential infrastructure (issuance, wallet, verification) built on W3C verifiable credentials and OpenID4VC standards, designed for population-scale services and offline use.
leads.hook: Their site lists SD-JWT, OpenID4VCI/OpenID4VP and ISO/IEC 18013-5 among the standards Inji follows.
leads.angle_reason: Inji handles personal credentials and consent-based sharing, the same auth and per-user data isolation problem MedVault solves for lab reports.

leads.summary: Open-source Laravel SaaS starter kit (auth, teams, Stripe billing, Slate UI) shipped as a Composer package by the Quick Brown Fox studio, which also builds client Laravel SaaS on it.
leads.hook: The kit keeps auth, teams and Cashier billing in vendor/ and ships AGENTS.md and llms.txt so Cursor and Claude agents install it correctly.
leads.angle_reason: Electrik is built around auth, team workspaces and roles, which MedVault covers with an email-based user model, refresh-token rotation and queryset-level isolation.

leads.summary: Blockchain Club SRM, apparently a student club given its name, with GitHub repos in JavaScript, Rust and TypeScript. No website text was scraped, so no product or company can be verified.
leads.hook: Only the posting line 'Adding to the Decentralized World' is available; there is no site text to cite.
leads.angle_reason: Their open-source JS, Rust and TypeScript repos are the kind of multi-file codebase Canopy maps as a call graph.
red_flags: no real product: student club, no company site text

leads.summary: A two-founder data journalism studio in Bangalore that builds public-data stories and tools (CBFC Watch, India Time Use Explorer, Mapping India's Clouds) and takes professional commissions.
leads.hook: CBFC Watch is a searchable database of 18k movies and 1 lakh censorship records built from public data.
leads.angle_reason: Their about page describes building full analysis pipelines from raw datasets, which Canopy does for code: parsing, cross-file graph resolution and a cached storage layer.
